title: Maxwell sells Promis software to Sandia

tellings.quote: So, he sold that to Sandia Labs.

plain: In the 1980s, the British publisher Robert Maxwell is said to have sold Promis, a piece of tracking software, to Sandia Labs, a US national laboratory in New Mexico. A researcher named Jason Simosa tells Michels this briefly ("he sold that to Sandia Labs") and names no source. It matters to him as a way secret software could have reached the heart of US weapons research.
